// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string

type get_labute_asa = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Return fraction of aromatic atoms (aromatic atoms / total atoms).
type get_fraction_aromatic_atoms = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Return number of aromatic atoms.
type get_num_aromatic_atoms = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Return aliphatic ring count using RDKit Lipinski.NumAliphaticRings.
type get_num_aliphatic_rings = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Return saturated ring count using RDKit Lipinski.NumSaturatedRings.
type get_num_saturated_rings = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Return count of cationic centers (atoms with formal charge > 0).
type get_num_positive_charge_atoms = (_: {

smiles: string
}) => any;

// Return count of anionic centers (atoms with formal charge < 0).
type get_num_negative_charge_atoms = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;
